title: Start Month for a TRICARE Prime Payment Method on File
content:
For an initial payment on a new fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment, the method on file has started when the account shows a payment collected through it from a starting month:

| The enrollment rests on | Starting month |
|---|---|
| a qualifying life event | the month after the month the application was received |
| an open season election | the first month of the plan year in which it took effect |
| otherwise | the month containing its effective date |

Payments are counted by posting date from the first day of the starting month.

## Hypothetical cases

- A qualifying-life-event enrollment applied for on 20 February, with an allotment payment posted 5 March: starting month March, so the method has started.
- The same enrollment with its only allotment payment posted 25 February: that payment is before March, so the method has not started.
- An open-season enrollment effective 1 January: starting month January of that plan year.
